title: Agent type-specific grounding context per dec_a788cc039b
context: Delegated agents need orientation when entering a fresh context. Previous approach gave all agent types an identical invariant digest, wasting context on irrelevant information and missing critical type-specific needs.
decision: Slice grounding context by agent type at SubagentStart: explorers receive the component map (what to search), planners receive live decisions + rejected alternatives (what not to re-propose), all others receive constraint digest (what not to violate).
consequences: Explorers orient from repo shape, not grep rounds — more efficient search strategy
Planners avoid re-proposing already-rejected alternatives — prevents wasted cycles and convergence loops
Other agent types get actionable constraints filtered to their scope — clearer operational boundaries
Each agent type receives ~2/3 the irrelevant context of one-size-fits-all approach — cheaper to execute
alternatives_rejected: One-size-fits-all invariant digest for all agent types (original — lost type-specific optimization opportunities)
No grounding at all (simpler but agents drift into blind re-exploration of solved problems)
Runtime agent self-selection of grounding (adds latency and coupling; type is known at spawn time)
